announce.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.ga: ALL of you... LOOK AT ME!
announce.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.in: Look at me, traveler... just once... and become a statue in my tomb.
announce.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.ph: The sands hunger... and so do I.
There is nowhere to flee from my GAZE!
announce.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.deat: ...the... kingdom... has fallen... rest... at last...
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.ambush: The mud hides me... where is the prey?
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.head_c: AAARGH! A head... it WILL return!
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.headle: No maws left... but the body still crushes!
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.intro: Sssss... warm flesh... in MY bog... every maw... hungry...
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.phase1: The bog boils! Swallow the venom!
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.phase2: Cut one... and two shall take its place! SSSSAAAH!
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.regrow: Ssss... two for one! Two for one!
announce.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.seared: FIRE! No... burnt flesh does not sprout!
announce.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.death: The sky... has lost... its king...
announce.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.intro: Who dares climb MY peak? The whole sky answers to me!
announce.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.land: Come, worms... face me on the ground!
announce.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.phase1: The winds obey! So does the thunder!
announce.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.storm: Only the sheltered survive my fury!
boss.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.subtitle: Warden of the Forgotten Kingdom
boss.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.subtitle: Mother of the Bog's Thousand Maws
boss.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.subtitle: Crown of the Storm
command.isekai_mahou.spawnboss.bosses_f_: Could not summon the boss here.
item.isekai_mahou.bosses_f.material_hint: Boss material — used by crafters and rituals.
item.isekai_mahou.bosses_f.trophy_hint: Boss trophy — required by Ascension rituals.
item.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk_eye.de: Don't stare for too long. Even dead, it still looks back.
Half scale, half stone — hot as desert noon.
item.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus_core.des: The mana-stone heart that made the ruins walk.
item.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus_rune.des: A chunk of ancient masonry with a rune that still glows.
item.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra_fang.desc: Still drips a greenish venom that eats through iron.
item.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra_heart.desc: It beats slowly even outside the body. They say the heads grow back from it.
item.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king_horn.desc: The crown of the lord of the peaks. The air around it smells of lightning.
item.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king_scale.desc: Blue as the storm; it sparks when rain falls.
message.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.gaz: Look away! Turn your camera away from the Basilisk (or hide behind something).
Total Gaze: TURN YOUR BACK on the Basilisk!
message.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.lea: The Basilisk returns to its tomb.
message.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.sta: You met the Basilisk's gaze... your body turns to stone!
message.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.armor: The stone armor absorbs almost everything — aim for the CORE in its chest when it opens!
message.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.core: It knelt with its core exposed — strike the CHEST now!
message.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.jump: Shockwave on the ground: JUMP at the right time!
message.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.leash: The Colossus returns to the ruins.
message.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.vent: The core overheated and opened: hit the chest (arrows and spells reach it)!
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.head_cu: Head severed! Burn the stump with FIRE before two grow back!
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.headles: No heads left: the body is exposed — hit it with everything!
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.leash: The Hydra retreats to its lair.
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.regrow: It regrew twice over... fire (flames, flaming arrows, Fire Aspect) stops it!
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.seared: Stump cauterized: that head won't come back!
message.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.water: Water puts out fire — lure the Hydra out of the bog to burn the stumps!
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.landed: The Wyvern has landed: your chance to strike up close!
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.leash: The Wyvern flies back to its peak.
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.storm: Tempest! Run into a GREEN ZONE before the lightning falls!
